blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Davao City information officer Jeffrey Tupas dismissed the allegations linking him to Vice President Sara Duterte’s suitcases of cash that Former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. claimed he delivered in his sworn affidavit. In his sworn statement dated Sept. 30, Tupas said that he did not know Gracioso, nor did he receive suitcases filled with cash for Sara. Gracioso, former aide of former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, alleged that he personally delivered suitcases to the vice president, former President Rodrgo Duterte, and Davao City 1st District Rep.
